signature: SUBROUTINE DLARRA( N, D, E, E2, SPLTOL, TNRM,

params.name: d
params.reference: On entry, the N diagonal elements of the tridiagonal matrix T.

params.name: e
params.reference: On entry, the first (N-1) entries contain the subdiagonal elements of the tridiagonal matrix T; `E(N)` need not be set. On exit, the entries E( ISPLIT( I ) ), $1 \le I \le \mathrm{NSPLIT}$, are set to zero, the other entries of E are untouched.

params.name: E2
params.reference: On entry, the first (N-1) entries contain the SQUARES of the subdiagonal elements of the tridiagonal matrix T; `E2(N)` need not be set. On exit, the entries E2( ISPLIT( I ) ), $1 \le I \le \mathrm{NSPLIT}$, have been set to zero

params.name: spltol
params.reference: The threshold for splitting. Two criteria can be used: $\mathrm{SPLTOL}<0$ : criterion based on absolute off-diagonal value $\mathrm{SPLTOL}>0$ : criterion that preserves relative accuracy

params.name: nsplit
params.reference: The number of blocks T splits into. $1 \le \mathrm{NSPLIT} \le N$.

params.name: ISPLIT
params.reference: The splitting points, at which T breaks up into blocks. The first block consists of rows/columns 1 to `ISPLIT(1)`, the second of rows/columns `ISPLIT(1)`+1 through `ISPLIT(2)`, etc., and the `NSPLIT`-th consists of rows/columns `ISPLIT(NSPLIT-1)`+1 through `ISPLIT(NSPLIT)=N`.
